text: Aim cursor: j/k walk the visible rows of the list
description: Slice 1 of 562cdb60. getVisibleAimRows (navigation-helpers) derives the rendered rows (top-level aims plus children of expanded aims, as index paths). navigateDown/Up step one row through list-store getAimListScope/selectAimRow/stepAimRow. Crossing a phase boundary enters at the first row going down and the last visible row going up. Replaces the per-level selectedIncomingIndex juggling, goToLastChildAim, and the stale-index condition. Cursor state is still encoded as selectedAimIndex/floatingAimIndex plus the selectedIncomingIndex chain; replacing that is slice 3.

status.comment: Implemented and unit-tested; needs Felix to try j/k through expanded aims in the list view (behavior change: j now enters an expanded aim's children).
